notes.title: Language Patch Update
notes.notes:
Laughter is universal and spreading joy across the world is our current mission. You can now update a free booster pack of content for The Jackbox Party Pack 9 which includes brand new content in French, Italian, German, and Spanish. 

This free update also includes minor bug fixes for your game. Be sure to save screenshots of your best in-game moments in our Steam community hub to prove to the world that you CAN be funny in German. 

To access this new content, simply install the latest version of The Jackbox Party Pack 9 in your Steam library.

[list]
[*] Additional content for French, German, Italian, Latin American Spanish and Castilian Spanish!
[*] Editorial fixes
[*] Minor bug fixes and performance enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes, new features, and SOON The Jackbox Language Pack free update!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Jackbox Party Pack 9 - Patch Notes[/h1]

On October 20th 2022, we released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850960/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_9/][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 9[/i][/url]. On November 17th 2022, we pushed out a patch to your copy right here on Steam. If you purchased The Jackbox Party Pack 9 through our website or on Steam, make sure to update to the latest version to receive the following updates: 

[h2]Fibbage 4[/h2]
[i]Features[/i]
Fibbage 4 includes the following feature updates:
[list]
[*]     Brand new themed episodes to discover!
[*]     30 new questions!
[*]     Lovingly tweaked art and sound!
[*]     Minor bug fixes!
[/list]
[h2]Junktopia[/h2]
[i]Features[/i]
Junktopia includes the following updates:
[list]
[*]     Updated Alt text/ text descriptions
[*]     New Items and content
[*]     New music and sfx
[*]     Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[h2]Nonsensory[/h2]
[i]Features[/i]
Nonsensory includes the following updates:
[list]
[*]     Additional prompts
[*]     Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[h2]Quixort[/h2]
[i]Features[/i]
Quixort includes the following updates:
[list]
[*]     Art and Gameplay updates
[*]     New theme song in the Credits
[*]     New sound effects
[*]     Updates to Forever Mode
[*]     Minor art and animation fixes
[*]     Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[h2]Roomerang[/h2]
[i]Features[/i]
Roomerang includes the following updates:
[list]
[*]     Winner moment updates (with confetti)!
[*]     New house backgrounds!
[*]     Updated player animations!
[*]     Players can now moderate goodbye speeches!
[*]     Minor bug fixes to controller & audience features!
[/list]

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]One more major announcement…[/h1]

In addition to these features, on [b]December 15th 2022[/b] we’re launching the Language Pack as a free update to The Jackbox Party Pack 9 on Steam. This will provide all players with an option in the settings menu to play every game in the pack in English, French, German, Italian, Latin American Spanish or Castilian Spanish.
